acceptance_criteria.statement: extract returns inline, reference, autolink and image links with 1-based line and verbatim destination span, and never returns links inside code blocks or code spans.
Reference-style links resolve their span inside the matching definition; unlocatable destinations return span None.
anchors and checkable_fragment keep audit's slug, duplicate-suffix, HTML id/name and line-anchor semantics.
classify_destination returns FragmentOnly, OtherExternal, Web, Unsupported, Absolute or Local exactly per the shape table, including backslash and drive-letter absolutes.
resolve_local percent-decodes and lexically normalizes, returning None on root escape; encode_destination round-trips through resolve_local.

Audit consumes the crate with unchanged findings and tests except the documented Absolute delta; install-ctl consumes it for closure, plan and span-based rewrites with warn (install) or refuse (autofix) on unlocatable spans.
The crate depends only on pulldown-cmark, every touched source file is at most 500 lines, and remote cargo install of install-ctl builds against published main branches.
